critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeSources.js line 91: onFile sets e.target.value='' BEFORE calling addFiles(files); this is fine because addFiles receives a reference to the FileList captured before reset, but under some browsers/automations the change event may be swallowed if the reset happens synchronously. Consider calling addFiles(files) first, then clearing the input.
Cosmetic: /kurse-uebersicht/ page uses 'Folgen' internally but tests looked for 'Episoden' — align terminology across marketing copy if 'Episoden' is the canonical CTA wording.
